Please help me keep quiet.

groups.sourceText: need to do sth. / need to paint them

items.exampleZh: 我现在需要做我的作业了。

items.example: We need to paint the walls red.
items.exampleZh: 我们需要把墙壁刷成红色。

groups.sourceText: look nice / looks nice / don't or doesn't look nice / sound great

items.example: The flowers look nice.
The pot looks nice.
items.exampleZh: 这个花盆看起来很漂亮。

items.example: These colours don't look nice.
items.exampleZh: 这些颜色看起来不好看。

items.example: This colour doesn't look nice.
items.exampleZh: 这个颜色看起来不好看。

items.example: Your idea sounds great.
The leaves change color in autumn.
How about going to the park this weekend?
items.exampleZh: 这个周末去公园怎么样？

items.example: What about having lunch at school today?
items.exampleZh: 今天在学校吃午饭怎么样？

items.example: Bamboo grows very fast in the south.

items.exampleZh: 这里的竹子被视为一种高贵的植物。

items.example: This is Chinese culture.
Let's solve the problem together.
items.exampleZh: 让我们一起解决这个问题吧。

He gave up smoking.

items.exampleZh: 在你的帮助下，我们完成了工作。

items.example: The weather becomes cold in winter.
It will become easier to do this.
items.exampleZh: 做这件事会变得更容易。

items.example: The problem becomes easier as we go on.
items.exampleZh: 问题随着我们继续而变得越来越简单。

items.exampleZh: 她上周学会了怎么拍照。
